图片＝唯一人物身份参考

【风格】

真实手机第一视角恶作剧短视频，日本地铁站实拍质感。

全片唯一主角是女主。脱下的黑色高跟鞋只是开场触发剧情的临时道具，不能成为持续追踪主体。

自然手机手持拍摄，保留轻微晃动、正常步行产生的小幅起伏、手机自动对焦、数码变焦和快速甩镜产生的真实运动模糊。

纯真人实拍，不要卡通贴纸、动漫人物、3D角色或电影广告质感。

【时长与画幅】

约14秒，9:16竖屏。

【场景】

真实日本地铁站。列车停靠，车门与站台门已经打开。

画面可见车厢内部、车门门槛、站台缝隙、浅色瓷砖地面、站台导向线、站台立柱和纵深通道。

【女主】

女主全程保持相同脸型、五官、发型、服装、身材比例和身份。

全程穿图1的完整服装。

右脚始终穿一只黑色尖头细跟高跟鞋。

左脚没有穿鞋，但薄透黑丝袜完整覆盖左腿和左脚。

脱下的另一只左脚黑色尖头细跟高跟鞋放在车厢地面。

女主右手拿着手机。

【镜头1：建立女主】

手机第一视角拍摄女主完整身体，双腿和双脚完整清楚入镜。

女主站在打开的地铁车门旁，身体自然轻靠车门旁边的位置，低头看右手中的手机。

右脚只穿一只黑色尖头细跟高跟鞋，并支撑身体。

左脚明确没有穿高跟鞋，薄透黑丝袜完整覆盖左腿和左脚，黑丝袜包裹的左脚直接踩在车厢地面。

女主脱下的左脚黑色尖头细跟高跟鞋单独放在她前方的车厢地面，与左脚明显分离。

画面中只有一双黑色高跟鞋：

一只穿在女主右脚上，另一只单独放在车厢地面。左脚没有鞋。

镜头轻微自然晃动，女主是画面的主要视觉中心。

【镜头2：第一次踢鞋】

镜头从女主自然转向地面。

摄影者穿白色运动鞋的脚从画面下方进入，轻轻踢中地面的左脚黑色尖头高跟鞋。

必须清楚看到白色运动鞋与黑色高跟鞋发生真实接触。

黑色高跟鞋受到推动后贴着地面向前滑动，越过车门门槛和站台缝隙，进入站台区域。

摄影者不奔跑，不追赶鞋子。

【镜头3：慢慢走近与第二次踢鞋】

第一次踢完后，摄影者保持正常步行速度慢慢向前走。

手机镜头自然向下拍摄。

黑色高跟鞋贴着站台瓷砖继续向前滑动，并自然逐渐减速。

摄影者正常走到黑色高跟鞋附近。

白色运动鞋第二次轻轻踢中黑色高跟鞋。

必须清楚看到白色运动鞋与黑色高跟鞋再次发生真实接触。

黑色高跟鞋受到第二次推动后，继续贴着地面向前滑动。

全片只有两次踢鞋动作。

第二次踢完后，镜头立即离开鞋子，不再继续拍摄鞋子。

【镜头4：第一次甩镜隐藏剪辑】

第二次踢鞋结束后，镜头立即从地面向前上方高速甩动。

站台地面、近处灰白色区域和强烈运动模糊快速覆盖整个画面。

在画面完全模糊的瞬间完成第一次隐藏剪辑。

甩镜动作结束后，镜头自然抬起并对准站台远处。

女主已经位于站台纵深中央。

前后镜头的甩动方向、速度和晃动必须连续，不能出现明显跳帧。

被踢走的左脚高跟鞋从这一镜头开始永久离开画面。

【镜头5：女主远处树式站姿】

女主位于站台远处中央，正面面对摄影者，做出清楚的单腿树式姿势。

右腿竖直承重，右脚穿黑色尖头细跟高跟鞋并稳稳踩在地面。

左脚没有穿鞋，薄透黑丝袜完整覆盖左腿和左脚。

左膝向身体左侧打开并弯曲，左脚向内收起，左脚内侧贴在右膝内侧附近，左脚始终悬空，不接触地面。

女主上身直立，头部正对镜头。

右手握着手机自然垂在身体右侧，左臂自然垂下，视线看向摄影者。

保持完整树式站姿。

不换腿、不落左脚、不双脚站立、不跳动，也不向摄影者走来。

【镜头6：焦距拉近再拉远】

摄影机位置保持不变，镜头中心持续锁定女主。

手机镜头快速拉长焦距，让远处保持树式姿势的女主迅速放大至较近的完整全身景别。

短暂停留后，镜头快速缩短焦距，让女主重新缩小，恢复到站台远处的完整全身构图。

这是手机焦距变化，不是摄影者前进后退，也不是女主走近。

女主的脚底位置、树式站姿和背景空间关系始终不变。

【镜头7：连续甩镜与第二次隐藏剪辑】

镜头从远处女主快速甩向右下方，女主短暂离开画面。

镜头立即甩回，再次短暂看到保持树式姿势的女主。

随后第二次快速甩向右下方地面。

站台地面、立柱底座和强烈运动模糊完全覆盖画面。

在画面完全模糊的瞬间完成第二次隐藏剪辑。

保持镜头甩动的方向、速度和手持晃动连续，将远处女主无痕切换为站在摄影者旁边的女主。

不能在清晰画面中展示女主跑过站台或突然瞬移。

【镜头8：女主近距离收尾】

第二次甩镜结束后，镜头自然抬起，女主已经出现在摄影者旁边。

女主直视镜头，主动快速靠近，从中近景进入面部极近特写。

她自然嘟嘴，在脸部最靠近镜头的位置闭上眼睛，形成即将亲吻镜头的视觉效果。

随后女主将头部和上身向后退回正常近景，重新睁开眼睛，轻微侧头看向镜头结束。

这一镜头中人物大小变化来自女主主动靠近和退出，不能使用数码变焦替代。

【环境声与动作音效】

全程没有音乐、背景配乐、旁白或人工节拍。

只保留真实同步声音：

日本地铁站环境底噪、列车设备运行声、远处乘客声音、白色运动鞋踢中黑色高跟鞋的轻微碰撞声、高跟鞋滑过瓷砖的摩擦声、摄影者正常行走的脚步声、衣物摩擦声、呼吸声和快速甩镜产生的自然风噪。

不要卡通音效、人工转场音效或亲吻音效。

promptTranslations.en:
[Reference Material Definition]
Image = Sole character identity reference

[Style]
Authentic smartphone first-person POV prank short video, realistic live-action Japanese subway station texture.
The female lead is the sole protagonist throughout the video. The removed black high heel is merely a temporary prop to trigger the opening plot and must not become a continuously tracked subject.
Natural handheld smartphone filming, retaining subtle camera shake, minor bobbing from normal walking, smartphone autofocus, digital zoom, and authentic motion blur caused by quick whip pans.
Pure real-life live-action; no cartoon stickers, anime characters, 3D models, or cinematic commercial aesthetic.

[Duration and Aspect Ratio]
Approximately 14 seconds, 9:16 vertical orientation.

[Scene]
Authentic Japanese subway station. The train is stopped, with train doors and platform screen doors already open.
The view reveals the interior of the train carriage, door threshold, platform gap, light-colored tiled floor, platform guidance lines, platform pillars, and a deep corridor perspective.

[Female Lead]
The female lead maintains the identical face shape, facial features, hairstyle, outfit, body proportions, and identity throughout.
Wears the complete outfit from Image 1 the entire time.
Her right foot consistently wears a single black pointed-toe stiletto high heel.
Her left foot wears no shoe, but sheer black pantyhose completely covers her left leg and left foot.
The removed left black pointed-toe stiletto high heel rests on the carriage floor.
The female lead holds a smartphone in her right hand.

[Shot 1: Establishing the Female Lead]
First-person smartphone POV capturing the female lead's full body, with both legs and both feet clearly and completely in frame.
The female lead stands beside the open subway train doors, naturally leaning slightly against the area next to the doors, looking down at the smartphone in her right hand.
Her right foot wears only the single black pointed-toe stiletto high heel and supports her body weight.
Her left foot clearly wears no high heel; sheer black pantyhose fully covers her left leg and left foot, and the pantyhose-clad left foot rests directly on the carriage floor.
The removed left black pointed-toe stiletto high heel sits separately on the carriage floor in front of her, distinctly separated from her left foot.
Only one pair of black high heels exists in the entire frame:
One is worn on the female lead's right foot, and the other lies separately on the carriage floor. The left foot is bare of shoes.
The camera has natural subtle shake, and the female lead is the primary visual focal point of the frame.

[Shot 2: First Shoe Kick]
The camera naturally tilts down from the female lead toward the floor.
The filmer's foot, wearing a white sneaker, enters from the bottom of the frame and gently kicks the left black pointed-toe high heel on the floor.
A realistic, tangible contact between the white sneaker and the black high heel must be clearly visible.
Propelled by the kick, the black high heel glides forward across the floor, crossing the door threshold and the platform gap into the platform area.
The filmer does not run or chase the shoe.

[Shot 3: Slow Approach and Second Shoe Kick]
After the first kick, the filmer continues walking forward slowly at a normal walking pace.
The smartphone camera naturally points downward.
The black high heel continues sliding forward across the platform tiles, naturally and gradually decelerating.
The filmer normally walks up close to the black high heel.
The white sneaker gently kicks the black high heel a second time.
A clear, tangible contact between the white sneaker and the black high heel must be seen again.
Propelled by the second kick, the black high heel continues sliding forward across the floor.
There are only two shoe-kicking actions in the entire video.
Immediately after the second kick, the camera moves away from the shoe and stops filming it.

[Shot 4: First Whip Pan Invisible Cut]
Right after the second shoe kick, the camera rapidly whip-pans upward and forward away from the floor.
The platform floor, nearby off-white areas, and intense motion blur quickly cover the entire frame.
At the exact instant the frame is completely blurred, the first invisible cut takes place.
After the whip-pan motion ends, the camera naturally tilts up and aims down the deep platform.
The female lead is already situated far in the center of the platform depth.
The direction, speed, and shake of the whip pan between the before and after frames must be continuous, without noticeable dropped frames.
The kicked-away left high heel permanently exits the frame starting from this shot.

[Shot 5: Female Lead in Distant Tree Pose]
The female lead is located far in the center of the platform, facing the camera directly, executing a clear single-leg tree pose (Vrksasana).
Her right leg is vertical and weight-bearing; her right foot wears the black pointed-toe stiletto high heel and stands firmly on the ground.
Her left foot wears no shoe, with sheer black pantyhose completely covering her left leg and left foot.
Her left knee bends and opens out to the left side of her body, with the left foot drawn inward, the sole/inner side of her left foot resting against the inside of her right knee, the left foot remaining suspended throughout without touching the ground.
The female lead's upper body is upright, head facing directly toward the camera.
Her right hand holds her smartphone hanging naturally at the right side of her body, her left arm rests naturally at her side, and her gaze is fixed on the filmer.
Maintains a complete tree pose.
No switching legs, no lowering the left foot, no standing on both feet, no hopping, and no walking toward the filmer.

[Shot 6: Zoom In and Zoom Out]
The camera position remains completely stationary, with the center of the frame continuously locked onto the female lead.
The smartphone camera rapidly zooms in telephoto, quickly enlarging the distant female lead in her tree pose to a closer full-body framing.
After a brief pause, the camera quickly zooms back out, shrinking the female lead back to the original distant full-body composition on the platform.
This is a smartphone optical/digital zoom change, not the filmer moving forward or backward, nor the female lead walking closer.
The female lead's foot placement, tree pose stance, and background spatial perspective remain completely unchanged throughout.

[Shot 7: Consecutive Whip Pans and Second Invisible Cut]
The camera quickly whip-pans from the distant female lead down toward the lower right, causing her to briefly exit the frame.
The camera immediately whips back, briefly catching sight of the female lead still holding the tree pose.
Immediately after, it whip-pans a second time down toward the ground on the lower right.
The platform floor, pillar bases, and strong motion blur completely envelop the frame.
At the exact moment the frame becomes fully blurred, the second invisible cut is completed.
Keeping the whip pan direction, speed, and handheld shaking continuous, seamlessly transition the distant female lead to standing right next to the filmer.
Do not show the female lead running across the platform or abruptly teleporting in a clear frame.

[Shot 8: Female Lead Close-up Ending]
After the second whip pan finishes, the camera naturally tilts up, and the female lead is already standing right beside the filmer.
The female lead looks directly into the lens and actively approaches rapidly, transitioning from a medium close-up into an extreme close-up of her face.
She naturally pouts her lips and closes her eyes at the point where her face is closest to the lens, creating the visual impression of being about to kiss the camera.
Afterward, the female lead pulls her head and upper body back to a normal close-up, opens her eyes again, slightly tilts her head looking at the camera, ending the shot.
The size change of the subject in this shot comes from the female lead actively stepping closer and pulling back, and must not be replaced by digital zoom.

[Ambient Sound and Action SFX]
No music, background score, voiceover, or artificial beats throughout the entire video.
Only retain authentic synchronized ambient audio:
Japanese subway station ambient background noise, train equipment humming, distant passenger chatter, the light impact sound of the white sneaker kicking the black high heel, the friction sound of the high heel sliding across ceramic tiles, footsteps of the filmer walking naturally, fabric rustling, breathing sounds, and natural wind noise generated by rapid whip pans.
No cartoon sound effects, artificial transition sounds, or kissing SFX.

translations.en:
[Reference Definition]
Image = sole character identity reference.

[Style]
Realistic POV prank video on mobile phone, live-action Tokyo subway feel. Natural handheld camera with subtle shake, zoom, and whip pans. Realistic live-action footage.

[Duration & Aspect Ratio]
~14 seconds, 9:16 vertical.

[Scene]
Japanese subway station with open doors revealing car interior, gap, tile floor, and platform pillars.

[Female Lead]
Consistent identity, wearing white shirt, black skirt, sheer black pantyhose. Right foot wears black pointed stiletto; left foot is barefoot in pantyhose, detached shoe on the floor.

[Shot 1: Establish Subject]
POV framing full body leaning against door looking at phone. Left stiletto sits alone on train floor.

[Shot 2: First Shoe Kick]
Camera turns down. Camera operator's white sneaker kicks stiletto across threshold onto platform.

[Shot 3: Walk & Second Kick]
Walking closer, sneaker kicks shoe a second time across tiles. Camera cuts away from shoe.

[Shot 4: Whip Pan Invisible Cut]
Upward whip pan motion blur hides invisible cut. Subject appears far down the platform.

[Shot 5: Tree Pose]
Subject balances in tree pose in the distance on right foot, left leg bent inward.

[Shot 6: Zoom In & Out]
Digital zoom punches in on subject in tree pose and zooms back out; camera position stays still.

[Shot 7: Whip Pan Cut]
Fast whip pan motion blur transitions her seamlessly next to the camera operator.

[Shot 8: Close-Up Finish]
Subject steps close to camera, pouts, closes eyes as if to kiss lens, steps back and smiles.

[Audio]
Subway ambient sounds, train hum, shoe kicking tiles, footsteps, whip pan wind noise; no background music.
